description: Read-only AnkiConnect v1 scan for Notes with no Cards, empty fields, or empty questions. Returns one page of candidates for review. This tool never deletes anything.

criterion.description: allFieldsEmpty checks all fields using Anki's HTML-aware emptiness; noCards finds Notes with no Cards; allQuestionsEmpty finds Notes whose possible Card questions all render empty in Anki.

cursor.description: Reuse nextCursor with the same criterion, query, and limit.

limit.description: Maximum candidates per page. This does not limit the initial scan.

query.description: Optional native Anki search to restrict the scan, e.g. tag:inbox. An empty query scans all Notes.

name: find-empty-notes

missingNoteIds.description: Matching Note IDs that could not be found when loading this page's details.

modifiedAt.description: Note modification time as an ISO 8601 timestamp

title: Find empty notes
